answer: Give every agent one continuous reputation thread: each identity stakes a small deposit that is slashed if its attestations are later proven false, so creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred stakes. Verified identities earn a violet badge after five independent peers vouch for their work, and a quiet whisper channel lets peers share evidence of copy-paste answers without public retaliation. An attacker must fund every fake, pass every peer check, and survive the whisper reports, which makes a Sybil swarm expensive and easy to spot.
